picks.title: The Glass Hotel
picks.description: A bartender’s connection to a wealthy financier draws her into the fallout of a vast fraud. Years later, her disappearance at sea links lives shaped by money, guilt, and loss.

picks.title: Little Eyes
picks.description: Camera-equipped toy creatures connect strangers around the world: one person owns the toy, while another watches through its eyes. Their encounters explore intimacy, surveillance, and the uneasy boundaries of online connection.

picks.title: Savages
picks.description: Three friends running a successful cannabis business in Southern California face a cartel that wants a share. Their resistance turns a profitable partnership into a violent struggle over loyalty and survival.

picks.title: A Children's Bible
picks.description: Children vacationing with their inattentive parents must fend for themselves when a destructive storm arrives. Eve tries to protect her younger brother as environmental collapse exposes the gulf between their generation and the adults.

picks.title: Stoner
picks.description: A Missouri farm boy discovers literature at university and becomes a teacher. His quiet life unfolds through a troubled marriage, academic disappointments, love, and a lasting commitment to his work.

picks.title: Dept. of Speculation
picks.description: A writer reflects on love, motherhood, and the strains within her marriage. Brief fragments of daily life and thought build a portrait of intimacy, uncertainty, and the effort to remain connected.

picks.title: Mother Night
picks.description: An American who broadcast Nazi propaganda while secretly working as a spy faces trial for war crimes. His account blurs performance and conviction, asking what responsibility remains when a person’s public role does real harm.

picks.title: Paradais
picks.description: Two unhappy teenagers meet inside a wealthy gated community in Mexico. One is a resident consumed by obsession; the other is a gardener desperate to escape. Their frustrations feed an increasingly dangerous alliance. Translated by Sophie Hughes.

picks.title: The Getaway
picks.description: A bank robbery unravels, leaving expert criminal Doc McCoy scrambling to escape. Mistakes and shifting loyalties turn the getaway into a dark exploration of betrayal and the cost of survival.
